rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Referent resolution under a sequential deck read.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Read all 7 content chunks sequentially, holding cumulative deck history. Closest call: chunk 2 line 20 'On the map, the kit is what stands in for you at Verification' -- 'the kit' has no explicit prior in-body naming. Resolves on two grounds: chunk 0's own lede (line 3) 'What you assembled to get there has names' primes the same referent one chunk earlier, and the module-arc-beats-in-openers/closers carve-out applies -- this lecture is placed directly after `diagnose-and-resend.md` in the module's include order (`grep -n "^\[Lecture\|^\[Exercise" curriculum/trainings/agentic-engineering-101/learn-from-the-test.md` run this session: '52:[Exercise: Diagnose and re-send]' then '57:[Lecture: What packaging is]', immediately adjacent), so 'the kit'/'your re-send' name the artefact-set the student just assembled in that exercise, the referent being the student's lived module. 'the diagnose-and-re-send you just ran' (chunk 1, line 13) and 'your re-send' (chunk 2, line 21) are the same carve-out. Chunk 3's header 'The verifier completes the three-pattern' (line 24) coins 'the three-pattern' at first use, but the chunk's own body (line 28, 'The other two sit alongside the three-pattern for next time') and the two immediately preceding chunks (which showed exactly 2 of the 3 pieces without yet naming them as a set) self-carry the referent under the chunk-0-is-prior-context and header-counts-as-in-chunk conventions; this is the file's documented naming beat, not a forward pointer to content that never lands. Chunk 7's 'the third shape on the verifier menu' (line 56) checked against `diagnose-and-resend.md` Phase 3 (`grep -n -A10 'Phase 3' curriculum/exercises/diagnose-and-resend.md` this session): the menu lists exactly 'LLM judge', 'Deterministic shell-hook', 'Ralph re-feed' in that order -- re-feed literally IS the third listed shape in the exercise the student just ran; resolves cleanly via the same module-arc carve-out, no cross-file positional guess needed. No never-named or vague-with-full-history referent found.

`sed -n '1,60p' curriculum/lectures/what-packaging-is.md | grep -inE "opening lecture|earlier lecture|prior lecture|previous lecture|last lecture|earlier module|prior module|previous slide|earlier slide|that (lecture|module)"` run this session -> exit 1, zero hits.
